tools.description: Get counts of NSW development applications by status, application type and council. tools.name: nsw_da_search_applications
tools.description: Search NSW development applications by council, suburb, postcode or lodgement date, newest lodgement first. Returns up to 100 development applications per call with address, status, cost, dwellings, storeys and development types, plus has_more for paging with offset. status, application_type, develo

tools.name: nsw_da_get_application
tools.description: Get the full record of one of the NSW development applications by its Planning Portal application number (PAN). Returns every location with lot and plan, all development types, submission, lodgement, determination and exhibition dates, cost, dwellings, storeys, lots and the remaining source fields.

tools.name: nsw_da_search_nearby_applications
tools.description: Find NSW development applications within 2 km of a street address or latitude/longitude, nearest first. Pass address (e.g. '10 Brigalow Ave, Casula') and it is geocoded against the official NSW address register, or pass lat and lng. Returns the distance in metres for each result plus the same fields

tools.name: nsw_da_resolve_address
tools.description: Resolve a NSW street address to its official form and latitude/longitude. Matches the address against the NSW address register and returns matched_address, lat and lng.
